Ensure you have a valid e-mail ID and mobile number for registration.

Provide a detailed pen picture (minimum 150 words) of each relevant experience in the application form.

Submit the application form and note down the generated registration number for future correspondence.

content_sections.heading: BEML Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There are a total of 20 vacancies available for various Assistant Manager and Engineer positions.

content_sections.heading: BEML Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals may apply. Candidates with Degree in Engineering from allied branches of Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics / CSE / IT can also apply, provided they possess the requisite Post Qualification Experience mentioned. Assistant Manager – T&C Rolling stock (Electrical & Mechanical): Minimum 4 years of post-qualification experience in rolling stock (Metro / Commuter Rail etc.) with at least 2 years of experience related to Testing, Commissioning & Maintenance of Rolling Stock. Assistant Manager (AMMS): 5 years of post-qualification experience in which a minimum 3 years of experience shall be in implementation of AMMS of Rolling stock (Metro / Commuter Rail etc.) or Computer maintenance management system like Maximo, SAP, Trimble E2M/R2M or others. Assistant Manager – Industrial Safety (OSHE): Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience in which 4 years shall be experience in safety management with application level knowledge of legislation & procedures, sound knowledge of hazardous materials & practices in large engineering industry. Engineer – T&C Rolling Stock (Electrical & Mechanical): Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience in Maintenance of Rolling stock (Metro / Commuter Rail etc.).

rows.qualification_required: Full-time, First-Class Degree in Electrical/Electronics/Railway Engineering from a recognized University/Institution. Desirable: M.E / M.Tech in relevant areas will be an advantage.
Full time, First Class Degree in Mechanical/Railway Engineering from a recognized University/Institution. Desirable: M.E / M.Tech in relevant areas will be an advantage.

rows.post: Assistant Manager Asset Maintenance Management System (AMMS) (Grade-III)
rows.qualification_required: Full-time, First-Class Engineering Degree in CSE / IT from a recognized University / Institution. Desirable: MCA will be an advantage.

Full time, First Class Degree in (Electrical / Mechanical Engineering) from a recognized University / Institution with Diploma in Industrial Safety from Central Labour Institutes / Regional Labour institutes or institutes recognised by Department of Factories and boilers.
Full time, First Class Degree in Electrical Engineering/ Rail Vehicle Technology/ Railway Engineering from a recognized University/ Institution.
Full time, First Class Degree in Mechanical Engineering/ Rail Vehicle Technology/ Railway Engineering from a recognized University/ Institution.

rows.post: Assistant Manager - T&C Rolling Stock (Electrical / Mechanical) (Grade-III)

rows.relaxation: Additional 10 years (over and above SC/ST/OBC(NCL) relaxation, minimum 40% disability)
Subject to equivalent years of excess post qualification experience prescribed (maximum age with relaxation shall not exceed 57 years)

content_sections.heading: BEML Salary
content_sections.text: Besides Basic Pay, candidates will be eligible for Variable Dearness Allowance, Perquisites & Allowances as applicable (currently 15.12% of the applicable Basic Pay under the Cafeteria System), Company Accommodation / House Rent Allowance, Provident Fund, Gratuity, PRP etc. as per prevailing Company Rules.

content_sections.heading: BEML Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is non-refundable and must be paid online by clicking the “Pay Application Fee Online” at the end of the application form.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BEML Recruitment
content_sections.text: Go to the official career page at the designated website. Ensure you have a valid e-mail ID and mobile number for registration. Fill out the online application form correctly. Provide a detailed pen picture (minimum 150 words) of each relevant experience in the application form. Upload scanned copies of all required documents and certificates. Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500/- online if applicable. Submit the application form and note down the generated registration number for future correspondence. Candidates employed in Central/State Government, Autonomous bodies, Quasi-Government and PSU must forward their printout of online form through proper channel or produce a "No Objection Certificate" at the assessment.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: X-th Marks card / Secondary School leaving certificate (SSLC) indicating date of birth XII-th Marks card Qualifying Degree Certificate and Marks cards Post-Graduation Marks cards and Certificate (as applicable) Identity card issued by Government of India (Aadhar, Passport, Driving License, PAN Card, etc.) Detailed Resume OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PwD certificate (as applicable) All Experience Certificates/Documents clearly indicating start & end dates of each employment Latest pay-slip Diploma in Industrial Safety Marks Cards and Certificate (only for position code no. 104)

content_sections.heading: BEML Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates shall apply for a single position which is most suitable. First class is reckoned at 60% as an aggregate of marks of all semesters/years, relaxable by 5% for SC/ST & PwD candidates. Candidates with CGPA/Credit must provide conversion to percentage. OBC (NCL) certificate must not be older than six months as on the last date of online application submission. Experienced candidates must provide a pen picture of minimum 150 words for each experience. Eligible candidates shortlisted for assessment must undergo pre-employment medical examination and document verification. Canvassing or influencing officials will result in immediate disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. What is BEML Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BEML Recruitment 2026 is an official notification released by BEML Limited to hire 20 executive positions including Assistant Manager and Engineer across various disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BEML Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 20 vacancies are available under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for BEML Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 22.10.2026 up to 18:00 Hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for BEML Assistant Manager Rolling Stock?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a full-time, first-class degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, or Railway Engineering from a recognized University/Institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for BEML Engineer positions?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 29 years for Grade-II Engineer posts and 30 years for Grade-III Assistant Manager posts, as on 22.10.2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for BEML Recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, General, EWS, and OBC candidates are required to pay a non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500/-, while SC, ST, and PwD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the pay scale for BEML Assistant Manager posts?
faq.answer: The pay scale for Assistant Manager (Grade-III) posts is Rs. 50,000 – 1,60,000.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for BEML Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply online through the official BEML career page at www.bemlindia.in before the closing date.
